entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:全無:0
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:全無:0
entries.en: none
entries.desc: 不指定特殊動作，保留一般姿勢動作系統。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:塗口紅:1
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:塗口紅:1
entries.en: applying lipstick with the lipstick bullet pressed to the lips, visible hand-to-mouth contact, slight lip pressure, polished beauty touch-up portrait moment
entries.desc: 以口紅膏體實際接觸嘴唇的補妝瞬間為主，重點是嘴唇因接觸與施力而出現些微擠壓變形，帶明確的美容行為與近距離寫真感。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:塗歪口紅:2
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:塗歪口紅:2
entries.en: messy lipstick application with the lipstick bullet touching the mouth, color smudged beyond the lip line, visible hand contact, imperfect beauty close-up moment
entries.desc: 以手持口紅實際往嘴唇塗抹、並且塗出唇線外的失手感或刻意塗歪效果為主，強調口紅道具清楚可見、顏色外溢、邊緣暈開與不完美的近距離美容特寫。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:喝冰咖啡:3
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:喝冰咖啡:3
entries.en: holding a clear plastic takeaway cup of iced coffee near the lips mid-sip, visible straw or cup rim, relaxed everyday cafe portrait moment
entries.desc: 以手持透明外帶塑膠杯裝的冰咖啡準備啜飲或剛啜飲的瞬間為主，重點是杯身清楚可見、帶生活感與刻意擺拍兼具的日常咖啡情境。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:咬著波板糖:4
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:咬著波板糖:4
entries.en: biting a colorful whirly pop swirl lollipop at the lips, candy prop clearly visible, playful portrait interaction with crisp mouth contact
entries.desc: 以咬著波板糖的瞬間為主，讓糖果本身成為明確視覺道具，帶一點俏皮與角色感，同時保留乾淨直接的人像構圖。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:抽煙:5
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:抽煙:5
entries.en: holding a cigarette between the fingers near the lips, faint smoke close to the face, controlled cinematic portrait gesture
entries.desc: 以手指夾著香菸靠近嘴邊的瞬間為主，煙霧只作為輕量氛圍，不讓道具過度主導畫面。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:整理絲襪:6
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:整理絲襪:6
entries.en: one hand pulling up a stocking on one leg, clear hosiery adjustment, visible hand-leg contact, fashion dressing gesture
entries.desc: 以單手拉起一側絲襪的穿戴整理動作為主，需要至少能清楚看到腿部與手部互動。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:前傾抓住褲腰:7
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:前傾抓住褲腰:7
entries.en: standing forward lean from the waist, both hands gripping the front waistband or belt loops, elbows angled outward, shoulders forward, energetic close-interaction pose
entries.desc: 以上半身從腰部向鏡頭前傾、雙手抓住褲腰兩側或皮帶環為主，手肘向外、肩膀前壓、臀部微微向後，帶有靠近鏡頭的互動感；不綁定特定場景。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:側坐單手後撐:8
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:側坐單手後撐:8
entries.en: side-saddle seated pose with both legs folded to one side, one hand planted behind the body, torso leaning back, relaxed asymmetrical support
entries.desc: 以側坐、雙腿折向一側、一手在身後或身側支撐身體的動作為主，不綁定特定場景或道具。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:抱膝托腮坐姿:9
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:抱膝托腮坐姿:9
entries.en: seated pose with knees drawn close to the chest, elbows near the knees, both hands cupping the cheeks, intimate front-facing seated posture
entries.desc: 以膝蓋靠近胸前、雙手托腮、手肘靠近膝蓋的正面坐姿為主，不綁定特定場景或道具。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:仰躺雙手微抬:10
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:仰躺雙手微抬:10
entries.en: lying on her back, arms bent beside the shoulders, hands softly lifted near the head, calm open upper-body resting pose
entries.desc: 以仰躺、雙手在肩膀或頭部兩側自然微抬的休息動作為主，不綁定特定場景或道具。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:跪坐回眸撩髮:11
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:跪坐回眸撩髮:11
entries.en: kneeling seated pose with the body turned away, looking back over the shoulder, one hand touching the hair near the head, over-the-shoulder portrait action
entries.desc: 以跪坐或坐在小腿上的回眸姿態為主，身體背向鏡頭、一手抬起觸碰頭髮，不綁定特定場景或道具。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:半脫上衣整理肩線:12
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:半脫上衣整理肩線:12
entries.en: pulling the top partially off one shoulder while adjusting the fabric, one hand holding the neckline, fashion styling gesture
entries.desc: 以把上衣肩線拉下一點並整理布料的造型瞬間為主，偏服裝 styling 動作而不是完整脫衣事件。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:隨性癱坐在雕花單人絨布沙發上:13
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:隨性癱坐在雕花單人絨布沙發上:13
entries.zh: 隨性癱坐在雕花單人絨布沙發上
entries.en: lounging in a casual sprawl on an ornate carved velvet armchair, body slumped or draped across the seat, editorial location-contrast portrait action
entries.desc: 以被刻意放進場景裡的雕花單人絨布沙發為核心，整體姿勢偏慵懶隨性，允許人物自然癱坐、倚靠、斜躺或半躺在沙發上，重點是鬆弛而帶企劃感的擺拍狀態。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:趴臥滑手機:14
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:趴臥滑手機:14
entries.en: lying on her stomach with upper body propped on forearms, holding a cell phone in one hand, legs bent upward with crossed ankles, casual lounging action
entries.desc: 以俯臥趴姿滑手機的放鬆瞬間為主，上半身由前臂支撐，雙腿抬起交疊，適合帶一點私密感的休閒企劃。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:靠牆站立:15
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:靠牆站立:15
entries.en: standing with one side of the upper body resting against a wall, weight shifted naturally, relaxed asymmetrical wall-lean pose
entries.desc: 以單側肩膀或上臂輕靠牆面的站姿為主，重點是身體重心偏向一側、姿態自然不對稱，帶有輕鬆克制的倚牆感。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:靠牆坐姿:16
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:靠牆坐姿:16
entries.en: sitting on the floor with the full back resting against a wall, both legs extended forward, relaxed grounded wall-seated pose
entries.desc: 以坐在地面、整個背部貼靠牆面、雙腿向前自然伸直的姿態為主，整體偏安靜、放空、帶一點倦懶感的靠牆坐姿。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:靠牆後仰站姿:17
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:靠牆後仰站姿:17
entries.en: standing with the full back leaning against a wall, body angled into a controlled backward recline, legs supporting the weight, arms relaxed at the sides
entries.desc: 以整個背部貼靠牆面、身體向後斜仰並由雙腿站立支撐的姿態為主，重點是像被牆面承接住的懸浮後仰感，以及垂直牆面與身體斜線形成的特殊張力。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:靠牆仰躺抬腿:18
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:靠牆仰躺抬腿:18
entries.en: reclining on the floor with upper body leaned against a wall, both legs lifted upward in staggered angles, raised-leg silhouette with compressed space tension
entries.desc: 以靠牆仰躺、上半身後靠、雙腿向上抬起並交錯延伸的姿態為主，重點在腿部形成的高低交錯線條與帶點壓縮空間感的擺拍張力。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:側身斜躺伸腿:19
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:側身斜躺伸腿:19
entries.en: reclining on one side with upper body supported by one arm, legs stretched forward, one knee slightly bent, elongated relaxed body line
entries.desc: 以側身斜躺並延伸腿部的姿態為主，強調修長線條與舞者般的舒展感，需要清楚看到整體肢體延伸。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:跪姿前傾倚靠高背:20
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:跪姿前傾倚靠高背:20
entries.en: kneeling on both knees on a seat or platform, upper body leaning forward, forearms folded across a tall backrest, supported stretched-torso pose
entries.desc: 以雙膝跪在座面或平台上、上半身前傾並把前臂交疊倚靠在高處支撐物上的姿態為主，重點是前傾延伸的上半身、微微後提的臀部與被支撐住的放鬆倚靠感。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:四足跪姿前傾:21
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:四足跪姿前傾:21
entries.en: on all fours with both hands and knees on the ground, torso leaning forward, arms extended, back arched, hips lifted, head angled downward
entries.desc: 以四足跪姿前傾的誇張肢體張力為主，背部拱起、臀部抬高，需要大範圍肢體可見才能成立。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:抱枕俯臥回眸:22
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:抱枕俯臥回眸:22
entries.en: lying prone with her torso propped on a large pillow, turning over the shoulder, hips lifted in an arched posture, knees grounded behind
entries.desc: 以俯臥抱枕並回眸的姿勢為主，強調靠枕、拱起的身體曲線與帶點私密感的回望瞬間。

entries.id: character:特殊動作-special-actions:分腿跪坐仰視:23
legacyIds: character:特殊動作-special-actions:分腿跪坐仰視:23
entries.en: kneeling with legs spread and feet tucked under, torso sitting back toward the heels, palms planted between the thighs, head dipped with upward eyes
entries.desc: 以分腿跪坐、雙手撐地、低頭抬眼的誇張肢體張力為主，重點在前挺胸口與壓低頭部形成的視線反差，需要清楚看到完整跪姿。
